_comment: Source of truth for user-scope MCP servers. install.sh/install.ps1 registers each via 'claude mcp add-json -s user', skipping (and unregistering) a server whose stdio command isn't installed or whose ${VAR} is empty in secrets.env. NO SECRETS HERE — values come from secrets.env (gitignored) at launch. See .env.example. notion authenticates with OAuth from Claude Code: run `claude mcp login notion` (or open /mcp) once per machine. github can't: its OAuth server has no dynamic client registration, so it takes a PAT.
_retired_comment: Unregistered by the installers. Slack and Vercel come from the claude.ai connectors instead (Slack's MCP needs a registered Slack app; Vercel's connector is the same server).
